name: runner-profile-integration
goal: Normal Vitest and Bun runners emit actual source-bound profiles while preserving production builds, benchmark boundaries and fixture isolation.

evidence: Direct adapter proof is green but no standard runner installs it. Actual Vitest and Bun child fixture operations return correct values with no captures. Production builds and unowned files must stay untouched.

Extend standardized source profiling to real runner imports and subprocesses. Require latency and RSS per executing runner, preserve source bytes and build artifacts, and prove ordinary, benchmark and unowned paths remain unobserved.
Committed f46368e1 red49719640: two real capture-count assertions fail, while ordinary and benchmark boundaries and unowned source pass.
Install evidence-only Vitest transform and a bounded Bun runtime hook. Use a separate owned sink and schema-validated registry; explicitly transpile TS and pass Bun preload as one equals-form option.

All nine unchanged adapter/runner cases pass. Vitest and Bun observations are distinct; build output stays original. Type, lint, audit and registry checks pass. Normal project configs are not yet enabled.
